newsitem.title: USA: Brent slips in subdued U.S. paper trading late.
newsitem.headline: Brent slips in subdued U.S. paper trading late.

text.p: North Sea Brent slipped in late U.S. paper trading on Tuesday, market sources said.
Three partial May cargoes were sold at $19.50, 19.52 and $19.53 a barrel, down from $19.55 at the settlement of London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE).
April/May Brent was talked around minus 30 cents, steady with the afternoon.
May/June Brent traded twice in the aftermarket at minus four cents, also even with activity earlier in the day.
